ConfigurableProduct:17595.faq:
What age group is this backpack and lunch bag for?

These bags are perfect for little ones in Daycare, all the way up to kids in early Primary. Our Backpacks are small enough for little ones to carry but big enough to fit all of their essential items.

Does the Lunch Bag fit inside the Backpack?

Yes! It comfortably fits inside our school bag with plenty of room for other school items. Our Lunch Boxes also fit inside these Lunch Bags.

Can I get these printed without my child's name?

Yes we can print these bags without a name and just the design. Simply enter some spaces in the name section and our production team will print your order without personalisation.

description.html:
Whether it's school days or weekend outings, we've got your kid's back(pack) and snack(pack) covered!

Kids' Backpack
Looking for a school bag that's durable, roomy and comfortable to carry for kids of all ages? Look no further than these Kids' Backpacks.

Designed to endure the school year and beyond, these fun and functional school bags are a hit with both kids and parents. They're machine-washable, have comfy padded straps and equipped with durable crocodile zips that are easy for kids to open and close. 

Best of all, these have three spacious compartments that keep lunches, books and small items separate. There's even a handy mesh-side pocket for their Personalised Drink Bottle. 

Kids' Backpack Size:

  • Main Body - 28cm wide x 37.5cm high x 19cm deep (11" x 14.7" x 5.9")
  • Front Pocket - 20cm wide x 20cm high x 4cm deep (7.9" x 7.9" x 1.6")

Lunch Bags
Wanna know why Aussie parents and kids love our Lunch Bags so much? They're extra tough, easy to clean and hold our Bento Lunch Boxes perfectly! Plus, these are a great size to pop into the zipped section of their Kids' Backpacks!

Spacious enough for all your little ones lunches and snacks, these Lunch Bags are perfect for keeping the food you prepared yummy and fresh until lunch time comes around.

With a silver insulated interior, handy mesh pocket, reinforced handle and easy machine-washable care, these bags are the ultimate lunchtime must-haves. 

Lunch Bag Size: 19cm wide x 23cm high x 8cm deep (7.4" x 9" x 3.1").

Not a fan of having your kid's name on their items? That's okay! Simply enter some spaces in the name section and our production team will print your order without personalisation. These School Backpacks and Lunch Bags look great even when they're customised without your kid's name.

Don't miss out on this fantastic duo! Order this Backpack and Lunch Bag Combo now.

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields of these kids & toddler school bags and lunch bags will be what is printed, so please make sure to double-check your spelling.
